live_interval.rationale: Whole downloaded upload (part 1, 2043.67 s). Timeline revision run: v2 OCR empty-line fallback and short-part merge policy. The upload ends during mission 3 (third, forced team) with no post-game reveal. Run full-v2b supersedes full-v2 by adding bar-less subtitle capture (layout v2); full-v2 is kept as an intermediate run.

Opening includes private evil-team night discussion; extraction starts after the host says dawn at 38 s. Tail switches to private assassination discussion between 1524 and 1526 s; extraction ends at 1525 s, with review required before export.

Own source: rules animation and producer identity-view announcement end before 225.4 s. Live player speech begins at 225.4 s. At 1519 s the video switches to private evil-team assassination discussion. Stop at 1518.5 s; exact nearby captions remain reviewable.

Own-source frame checks: rules still visible at 226.0, live seat 1 begins by 226.5. Third mission result appears by 2054, post-game label explicitly visible at 2056. Stop at 2055.3; no post-game speech enters input.

Own-source frame check: pre-game identity viewing at 240.0, first seat-9 speech by 241.017. Public discussion until 1658.017; wolf-only discussion label appears by 1658.25. Boundary evidence saved privately.

Own-source checks: pre-game viewing at 236.0, seat-1 first speech by 238.0. Final mission-4 result visible in the compact public board by 2512; role-revealing animations remain outside public regions. Explicit winner reveal from 2514 and post-game from 2518 are excluded.

Full feature. 0-247 s is a teaser ('本期导视' + '正片跳转至4分07秒' = 247 s) replaying later clips. The client's own caption at 1797.4 s reads '任务成功，2号刺客决定发动刺杀' — it names the assassin — and from 1802 s the speaker label reads 刺杀梅林讨论 (the evil team picking a target), then 赛后. live_game_interval therefore ends at 1797.3 s, just after the bare '任务成功' caption (on screen 1796.0-1797.2 s) and before the leaked variant. Extraction runs to 1810 s so a reviewer can see the switch in the evidence instead of taking the boundary on trust. Media is the verified 1080p HEVC stream (sources/verify.BV1kr876AEE1.hevc.json).

Full feature. 0-238 s is a teaser whose captions read out roles (t=70 s shows 忠臣忠臣刺客), so it is excluded entirely; the first in-game speech is at 240 s. The client caption reads 有一票破坏 through 2175.52 s and switches at 2175.75 s to 本场游戏莫德雷德的爪牙阵营胜利, which names the winning side and a role; from 2186 s the speaker label reads 赛后. live_game_interval therefore ends at 2175.75 s. Extraction runs to 2190 s so the switch stays visible in the evidence.

Cold open ends at 49.27 s; extraction retains 49.3..1890 for audit. Actual public play starts at 60.5 s and stops just after mission 4 result at 1843.55 s. The last 46 s are endgame reactions and post-game role reveal (explicit 赛后 from 1857.65 s), contrary to the earlier unreviewed note.

0..274.3 s is a teaser/rules animation. At 274.517 s live opening speech is visible. Fifth mission success is visible at 1950 s; after 1952.5 s the host names the assassin and the edit moves to private evil-team discussion. Boundaries checked on private/boundary-check images.

Usable window of this upload. 0-238 s is a teaser ('正片跳转至3分58秒' burned into the first frames) replaying later clips out of order. From ~1273 s the edit switches to '狼人盘刀' (the evil team choosing an assassination target) and then '赛后'; both are answer-bearing and are excluded by live_game_interval rather than by the extraction interval, so the boundary itself stays visible in the evidence. The extraction runs 12 s past the switch so the reviewer can see where it happens.

Own source starts live seat-7 speech. Last public seat-1 speech ends about 1907.8; explicit assassin activation begins by 1908.3. Cut at blank subtitle at 1908.1. Fourth mission result only appears after this identity reveal, so no fourth-result cutoff is asserted.
